what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5771 Somali refugees in Sweden, 0.6% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1986 to 2025, at war level in most of the years since 2006, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 1083 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 22548, at the end of 2016.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2010 to 2020, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
